hypotheses.text: If Idris Calloway had been 2 m closer to Kai Nakamura, that nearer defensive pressure and reduced shooting space would have materially lowered Kai’s chance to score compared with the 4.6% observed.
If Mateo Brann had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, his proximity would have restricted Kai’s time and angle on the shot and therefore decreased the observed 4.6% chance to score.
